verdict.rationale: ZCode ships its own terminal agent and a `zcode` command that passes extra arguments to an Agent CLI. It can also start a Web server with `--no-open`, so it runs from the shell without the desktop GUI. However, nothing documents a non-interactive or prompt-driven mode, CI usage, or machine-readable output. A community comment calling it GUI-only appears outdated next to the GitHub docs, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless execution mode, CI integration guidance or examples, structured output and exit-code behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.
